mapper.update: update BIZ_TASK set PROGRESS_RATE = IF(FINISH_STATUS = 100,1, 0.01*FINISH_STATUS), AUTO_FLAG = IF(FINISH_STATUS = 100,100,1), UPDATE_TIME = current_time, AUTO_MEMO = CONCAT( IF(AUTO_MEMO is null,'',AUTO_MEMO), ' 进度分系数第一次自动计算：计算时间【',NOW(),'】，计算时任务完成进度为【',FINISH_STATUS,'%】，','本次计算结果为【',PROGRESS_RATE,'】') where STATUS in ('1','100') and DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and date(DATE_ADD(END_DATE,INTERVAL 7 DAY)) = date(NOW()) and FINISH_STATUS IS NOT NULL and PROGRESS_RATE IS NULL

update BIZ_TASK set PROGRESS_RATE = IF(FINISH_STATUS = 100,PROGRESS_RATE, 0.5*PROGRESS_RATE), AUTO_FLAG = IF(FINISH_STATUS = 100,200,2), UPDATE_TIME = current_time, AUTO_MEMO = CONCAT( IF(AUTO_MEMO is null,'',AUTO_MEMO), ' 进度分系数第二次自动计算：计算时间【',NOW(),'】，计算时任务完成进度为【',FINISH_STATUS,'%】，','本次计算结果为【',PROGRESS_RATE,'】') where STATUS in ('1','100') and DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and date(DATE_ADD(END_DATE,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = date(NOW()) and FINISH_STATUS IS NOT NULL and AUTO_FLAG = 1

update BIZ_TASK set PROGRESS_RATE = IF(FINISH_STATUS = 100,PROGRESS_RATE, 0), AUTO_FLAG = IF(FINISH_STATUS = 100,300,3), UPDATE_TIME = current_time, AUTO_MEMO = CONCAT( IF(AUTO_MEMO is null,'',AUTO_MEMO), ' 进度分系数第三次自动计算：计算时间【',NOW(),'】，计算时任务完成进度为【',FINISH_STATUS,'%】，','本次计算结果为【',PROGRESS_RATE,'】') where STATUS in ('1','100') and DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and date(CONCAT(YEAR(END_DATE),'-12-31')) = date(NOW()) and FINISH_STATUS IS NOT NULL and AUTO_FLAG = 2
